rules.statement: The presumption created by Section 6 of the Crown Encroachment Ordinance, No. 12 of 1840, in favor of the Crown applies to lands which were chena at the time of the encroachment.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the Ordinance is a general enactment laying down once for all what kind of lands shall be considered the property of this Crown, and incidentally providing a summary remedy against trespassers on Crown property. The character and description of the land must be considered as at the time when the act which constitutes the encroachment is done."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 6 of Ordinance No. 12 of 1840, all forest, waste, and chena lands are presumed to be Crown lands, unless the person claiming the land can prove a title.
